claim: Isaac ROS getting started: packages tested with ROS 2 Lyrical; platforms Jetson Thor/Orin on JetPack 7.2, x86_64 with Ubuntu 24.04 + CUDA 13.2+, DGX Spark on DGX OS 7.2.3; Ubuntu 26.04 not listed; Docker is the recommended isolation mode [status note: TAG REF-W2-robotics]
JetPack 7.2.1 (Jetson Linux 39.2.1, 2026-08-11) is based on L4T Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8, supports Thor T5000/T4000 and Orin; Isaac ROS listed as Coming soon [status note: TAG REF-W2-robotics]

rmw_zenoh backported a wire-breaking change to ROS 2 Jazzy (0.2.5 cannot communicate with 0.2.3 or earlier; mismatch crashes the process); maintainers commit to wire compatibility from Kilted onward [status note: TAG REF-W2-robotics]

Ubuntu 25.10: rust-coreutils 'date -r' bug made apt.systemd.daily compute zero elapsed time so unattended upgrades never ran; Launchpad #2129660 (dup of #2127970) reported 2025-10-23; users told to run apt update manually [status note: TAG REF-W2-robotics]

Canonical (2026-04-22): Ubuntu 26.04 ships rust-coreutils 0.8.0 but keeps cp, mv and rm on GNU coreutils because 8 TOCTOU issues from the Zellic audit (113 issues over two rounds) remain open; later thread replies report install symlink breakage and an unverified file-corruption bug [status note: (post); replies are user reports; TAG REF-W2-robotics]

Fedora Quality proposal (2025-07-29) to reconsider Fedora IoT Edition status: 'we believe just two maintainers', countme 'just under 4k' weekly check-ins, QA workload; a QA member notes loss of the dedicated IoT QA contributor [status note: TAG REF-W2-robotics]
Proposal withdrawn 2025-09-08 because 'the Fedora IoT team decided to take over most of the Quality tasks'; Fedora IoT remains an Edition [status note: TAG REF-W2-robotics]

User report (2023-05-24) of Fedora 38 Silverblue on Jetson AGX Orin: boots, no Ethernet driver, nouveau software rendering, NVIDIA CUDA driver package prevents boot, CUDA TODO; 'not supported by NVIDIA' [source: community forum] [status note: dated, low weight; TAG REF-W2-robotics]
